Name: Mizu's Goose
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
Honk honk, geese are here! This mod is for you if you like all things about goosey ganders! It adds geese as a new [b]coop [/b]animal. 

[list]
[*]Geese lay [b]Goose Eggs[/b] every three days.[/*]
[*]Geese drop [b]Goose Down [/b]at high friendship.[/*]
[*]Geese can be purchased from Marnie after you build a [b]Big Coop[/b].[/*]
[*](Optional) Golden Geese lay [b]Golden Goose Eggs.[/b] You can find the eggs in [b]Mr. [/b][b]Qi's Walnut Room[/b] after achieving [b]Perfection.[/b][/*]
[*](Optional) Enables [b]Golden Goose Mayonnaise[/b] to match mods which add Blue Mayonnaise and Golden Mayonnaise for chickens. (Requires Golden Goose to be turned on.) [/*]
[/list]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] required to play this mod. [/b]It allows the animal to squeeze through the small door of the coops.

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] compatibility, with 3 new recipes to find and cook up. These recipes use all vanilla items (+ goose meat) or, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] installed, some of them will change to use those items instead. There is an additional recipe if it's your preference, but it is disabled by default.

This mod has optional effects with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] installed to change the text of the recipe book when learning. It's entirely aesthetic.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img]﻿[/b][/center]
By default the White and Gray appearances are enabled. You can toggle on more below.

[b]Enable Brown Goose [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables the Brown Goose texture and adds it to the possible goose appearances.
[b]Enable Wild Goose[/b] (false by default): Enables the Wild Goose texture and adds it to the possible goose appearances.
[b]Enable Foie Gras[/b] (false by default): Enables the foie gras recipe. Sold by Krobus.
[b]Enable Golden Goose[/b] (false by default): Enables the Golden Goose, a separate species which lays golden goose eggs. Requires the same as Golden Chickens to get.
[b]Enable Golden Goose Mayonnaise[/b] (false by default): Enables the Golden Goose Mayonnaise to have parity with other mods which add mayo for ostrich and blue eggs.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img][/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url]
4. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] for some bonus features
5. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
7. When starting up the game for the first time, use Generic Mod Config Menu to choose which options you want to turn on or off.
You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!
